drivingQuestion: Why must the mishna list every improper dating?
outcomeNote: All the listed dating cases are shown to be necessary.

segments.he: וְאִי אַשְׁמְעִינַן מַלְכוּת מָדַי וּמַלְכוּת יָוָן – מִשּׁוּם דְּמַלְכְוָתָא הָווּ; אֲבָל בִּנְיַן הַבַּיִת – מַאי דַהֲוָה הֲוָה;
segments.en: «And if» the mishna «had taught us» this halakha with regard to «the kingdom of Media and the Greek Empire,» one could understand the concern, «because they were kingdoms,» and the current government objects to another kingdom being mentioned in a document. «But» if he wrote the date counting to «the building of the Temple,» then one could say «what was, was,» and the local government is not particular if this is mentioned in a document. Consequently, it was necessary for the mishna to teach us this halakha as well.

segments.he: וְאִי אַשְׁמְעִינַן בִּנְיַן הַבַּיִת – דְּאָמְרִי: קָמַדְכְּרִי שְׁבָחַיְיהוּ; אֲבָל חוּרְבַּן הַבַּיִת, דְּצַעֲרָא הוּא – אֵימָא לָא; צְרִיכָא.
segments.en: «And if» the mishna «had taught us» this halakha with regard to «the building of the Temple,» then one could say that the reason why this is problematic is because the governments «will say:» The Jews «mention their» own «praise,» instead of honoring the ruling government. «But» with regard to «the destruction of the Temple, which is a» cause of «anguish» for us, «say» that «no,» the government is not particular about this. Therefore it is «necessary» to mention all of these halakhot.

moves.cueHe: ואי אשמעינן מלכות מדי ומלכות יון
moves.summary: From Media and Greece one would not derive the Temple's building
From the building one would not derive the destruction
Therefore all the cases are necessary

edges.about: each dating case is needed: Media/Greece do not teach the Temple's building, and the building does not teach its destruction
